Date : 07/08/2025  ORAL ORDER [1] Heard learned advocate for the applicants - original claimants.
[2] Pursuant to the notice issued upon the respondents, the applicants have served the notice upon respondent No.2.
[3] Learned advocate Mr. G.C.Mazmudar has entered appearance on behalf of respondent No.2 - Insurance Company.

[3.1] Learned advocate for the applicant, at the outset, has submitted that looking to the limited Taraben Bharatbhai Thakor vs Babubhai R Joshi on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178988385/

sentences.text: He has therefore urged to take up the matter for hearing.
[4] The matter is taken up for hearing in absence of respondent No.1.

[5] The present Civil Application is filed under Section 5 o  
 C/CA/3091/2025 ORDER DAT  
Limitation Act, 1963 read with Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, praying for condonation of delay of 62 days caused in preferring the appeal.
[6] It is submitted by the learned advocate for the applicants that due to death of the husband,
applicant No.1 was in state of mental shock, it took time for her to contact the advocate and to avail the remedy of appeal.
Since she was not well-versed with the legal proceedings, the delay had crept in.
[7] Considering the aforesaid explanation offered and the minimum number of days involved, this Court is inclined to exercise its discretion.

Considering the beneficial legislation and the applicants being original claimants who intend to prefer an appeal for enhancement of amount of compensation, the explanation offered by the applicants is accepted to be sufficient cause.
[8] Hence, the delay of 62 days caused in preferring the appeal is hereby condoned.
Accordingly, the Civil Application is allowed.
